fictionNotice: Every firearm in this archive is a fictional MAGIARCHY design. Named real-world firearms are visual and conceptual references only, not licensed copies or products that exist inside the story world.

manufacturer.name: Ren Arms
manufacturer.description: An established Narvean firearms manufacturer based in Rennel, the Ducal capital.
manufacturer.namingTradition: Its pistol models traditionally carry bird nicknames. Each bird broadly corresponds to the physical character, size, role, and perceived personality of the pistol.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the silver and dark Ren L17 Sparrow pistol
weapons.storyUse: Standard-issued pistol for every MSF officer who has passed weapons certification. MSF purchases the Sparrow from Ren Arms and does not manufacture firearms.
weapons.designSummary: A slim, compact, silver-finished pistol with an elegant and deliberately understated appearance. Its proportions sit conceptually between the Walther PPK and SIG Sauer P230, slightly more elongated and graceful than a PPK while retaining enough visual weight to avoid looking fragile.
characteristics: Exposed hammer and small conventional sights
Dark grip panels contrasting with silver metal
Smooth exterior surfaces and restrained controls
Designed for personnel who carry it far more often than they fire it
weapons.modernizationNote: Despite the Sparrow's older design lineage, current-production models omit an external manual safety to reflect the demands and handling priorities of modern combat.
weapons.finishNote: The silver finish belongs to the firearm itself rather than to an MSF customization. Routine issue gradually makes the ordinary Ren Arms product visually associated with MSF officers.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its small size, light visual presence, discretion, and modest chambering.

characterLinks.name: Lynleit
characterLinks.note: Carries the issued Sparrow as her personal sidearm.

weapons.imageAlt: Side profile illustration of the silver and dark Ren L19 Magpie with its optional compensator and extended magazine attached
weapons.familyPosition: Larger, louder, and heavier relative of the Sparrow
weapons.designSummary: An enlarged and strengthened development of the Sparrow for the more powerful 9×19 cartridge. It retains the older Ren Arms family line while becoming thicker, heavier, visually denser, and more assertive.
characteristics: Graceful slide profile and exposed hammer
Recognizably Ren Arms grip and frame lines
weapons.modernizationNote: Despite the Magpie's older design lineage, current-production models omit an external manual safety to reflect the demands and handling priorities of modern combat.
weapons.optionsSummary: Two optional attachments help the compact pistol remain controllable under the stronger recoil of its 9×19 cartridge.

options.name: Attachable compensator
options.effect: Reduces muzzle rise and helps the shooter maintain control under the Magpie's greater recoil.

options.name: Extended magazine
options.effect: Adds gripping surface for firmer recoil control while also increasing ammunition capacity.

weapons.finishNote: It fills the space between a discreet institutional pistol and a full modern duty handgun.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its close relationship to the Sparrow, with a larger, louder, heavier, and more noticeable character.

weapons.designSummary: The Rook moves Ren Arms into a micro-compact service philosophy. It is shorter, slimmer, and more carry-focused than the Sparrow and Magpie while retaining enough grip and slide length to remain credible for trained close-protection and institutional users.
characteristics: Modern styling without excessive decorative machining
weapons.variantNote: Ghost Comp is the Rook's compensated premium configuration, occupying the same conceptual place that a Spectre Comp-style model holds within a micro-compact family.
weapons.finishNote: The smallest modern service-oriented member of the family, intended for discreet carry without returning to the older metal-pistol language.
weapons.nameMeaning: A compact, practical, intelligent bird with more confidence and modern utility than a Sparrow.

weapons.designSummary: The Crow is the compact workhorse of the modern Ren Arms family. It is larger and easier to control than the micro-compact Rook while remaining suitable for concealed, bodyguard, police, and ordinary duty use.
characteristics: Compact proportions suited to concealed and duty carry
weapons.finishNote: It is neither prestigious nor exotic. It is the dependable all-purpose compact of the current family.
weapons.nameMeaning: Its common, capable, dark, and practical character.

weapons.designSummary: The Raven is the full-size workhorse of the modern Ren Arms line. It extends the Crow's service philosophy into a longer slide, taller grip, greater mass, and conventional full-size duty silhouette.
characteristics: Longer slide and taller grip than the Crow
Intended for police, military, security, and state service
weapons.finishNote: A serious, reliable full-size service pistol rather than a prestige object.
weapons.nameMeaning: A larger, darker, and more imposing service weapon than the Rook or Crow.

weapons.role: Premium large-frame precision and prestige pistol
weapons.designSummary: The Swan is Ren Arms at its most prestigious and mechanically deliberate. It combines the refined construction language of premium 2011 and 1911 pistols with the visual authority of a Desert Eagle-scale handgun and the controlled sophistication associated with the SIG GTO reference.
characteristics: Large premium frame and substantial slide
weapons.finishNote: A specialist or prestige choice rather than an ordinary standard-issued sidearm.
weapons.nameMeaning: Size, grace, refinement, and composure. A Raven should look like a full-size duty weapon; a Swan should look premium, powerful, and controlled.
